title: List the signed-in member's own links

scope_out: Editing a link from the list (SG-2); Any other member's links appearing (SG-5); Click counts, analytics, or export from the list (SG-4, SG-9)

entities.name: List the signed-in member's own links

operations.text:
1. Extend `backend/src/repository/link_repository.py` — add paginated `list_for_owner(owner_id, page, page_size=20)`.
2. Extend `backend/src/services/link_service.py` — add `list_links(owner_id, page)`.
3. Extend `backend/src/api/links.py` — add `GET /links` returning `LinkPage`.
4. Extend `frontend/src/app/api/links/route.ts` — add `GET` handler proxying to backend.
5. Create `frontend/src/types/link.ts`, `frontend/src/types/member.ts` — `LinkView`/`LinkPage`/`MemberView` mirrors.
6. Create `frontend/src/api/linksClient.ts` — `listLinks(page)`.
7. Create `frontend/src/components/LinkList.tsx`, `frontend/src/components/LinkRow.tsx`, `frontend/src/components/Pagination.tsx`, `frontend/src/components/EmptyState.tsx`.
8. Create `frontend/src/app/console/page.tsx` — server component rendering the list.
9. Add `backend/tests/integration/test_links_api.py::test_list*` and `frontend/tests/console/list.spec.ts` covering AC1–AC4.
